title: Visits Already Asked for Retroactively on an Insured Plan of Care
content:
On an Insured Plan of Care, visits already asked for retroactively are not asked for again:

| What stands on the plan | Taken off the visits asked for |
|---|---|
| Earlier retroactive requests | The visits they asked for |
| No earlier retroactive request, but retroactive approvals | The visits they granted |
| Neither | Nothing |

The visits asked for, after this is taken off, are never below zero.

## Questions and answers (hypothetical)

**Two earlier retroactive requests asked for 3 and 2 visits, and one approval granted 4. How many come off?** 5 — the visits the earlier requests asked for.

**No retroactive request is on file, but a retroactive approval granted 4 visits. How many come off?** 4.

**The count for the gap is 6 and earlier retroactive requests asked for 8. How many are asked for now?** None — 6 less 8 is below zero, so 0.
